SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) as unique_members_exposed
FROM fact_campaign_exposure
WHERE campaign_id = 19

SELECT 
    SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
WHERE f.member_key IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT member_key
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure
    WHERE campaign_id = 19
)
AND f.sale_date >= '2026-05-04'
AND f.sale_date <= '2026-05-24'

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as holdout_count
FROM campaign_holdout
WHERE campaign_id = 19

SELECT 
    campaign_id,
    campaign_name, 
    mailing_list_size,
    holdout_size,
    mailing_list_size - holdout_size as expected_exposed
FROM dim_campaign
WHERE campaign_id = 19

-- Get all members in the mailing list (including holdouts)
-- by checking who has any exposure records or is in holdout
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ce.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN ce.member_key END) as members_with_exposure,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ch.member_id IS NOT NULL THEN ch.member_id END) as members_in_holdout,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN ce.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN ce.member_key 
        WHEN ch.member_id IS NOT NULL THEN ch.member_id 
    END) as total_unique_members
FROM fact_campaign_exposure ce
FULL OUTER JOIN campaign_holdout ch ON ce.member_key = ch.member_id AND ce.campaign_id = ch.campaign_id
WHERE ce.campaign_id = 19 OR ch.campaign_id = 19

-- Get spending for members not in holdout
SELECT 
    SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net_sales_targeted_members
FROM fact_sales_line f
WHERE f.member_key IN (
    -- Get members who were NOT held out
    SELECT dm.member_key
    FROM dim_member dm
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM campaign_holdout ch
        WHERE ch.campaign_id = 19 AND ch.member_id = dm.member_id
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        -- Verify member was part of the mailing list (check exposure or other indication)
        SELECT 1
        FROM fact_campaign_exposure ce
        WHERE ce.campaign_id = 19 AND ce.member_key = dm.member_key
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 1
        FROM campaign_holdout ch
        WHERE ch.campaign_id = 19 AND ch.member_id = dm.member_id
    )
)
AND f.sale_date >= '2026-05-04'
AND f.sale_date <= '2026-05-24'

-- Check if any holdout members made purchases during the campaign period
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.member_key) as holdout_members_who_purchased,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as spending_by_holdout_members
FROM fact_sales_line f
WHERE f.member_key IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_key
    FROM dim_member m
    INNER JOIN campaign_holdout ch ON ch.member_id = m.member_id
    WHERE ch.campaign_id = 19
)
AND f.sale_date >= '2026-05-04'
AND f.sale_date <= '2026-05-24'

-- Get total spending by all members in the mailing list (both exposed and holdout)
SELECT 
    SUM(f.net_amount) as total_spending_all_mailing_list_members
FROM fact_sales_line f
WHERE f.member_key IN (
    -- Get all members who were part of the mailing (exposed or held out)
    SELECT DISTINCT ce.member_key
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure ce
    WHERE ce.campaign_id = 19
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_key
    FROM dim_member m
    INNER JOIN campaign_holdout ch ON ch.member_id = m.member_id
    WHERE ch.campaign_id = 19
)
AND f.sale_date >= '2026-05-04'
AND f.sale_date <= '2026-05-24'

-- Check if any members in exposure were also in holdout
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT ce.member_key) as exposed_also_in_holdout
FROM fact_campaign_exposure ce
INNER JOIN campaign_holdout ch ON ce.member_key = ch.member_id
WHERE ce.campaign_id = 19 AND ch.campaign_id = 19

-- Check spending for exposed members more carefully
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.member_key) as members_with_spending,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ce.member_key) as total_exposed_members,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as total_spending
FROM fact_campaign_exposure ce
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON ce.member_key = f.member_key 
    AND f.sale_date >= '2026-05-04'
    AND f.sale_date <= '2026-05-24'
WHERE ce.campaign_id = 19
GROUP BY ce.campaign_id

-- Recalculate using member_id (stable identifier) to avoid SCD issues
-- First get the member IDs of exposed members
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) as total_exposed_members,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as total_spending
FROM fact_campaign_exposure ce
INNER JOIN dim_member m ON ce.member_key = m.member_key
INNER JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.member_key IN (
    SELECT member_key FROM dim_member WHERE member_id = m.member_id
)
WHERE ce.campaign_id = 19
AND f.sale_date >= '2026-05-04'
AND f.sale_date <= '2026-05-24'

-- Get exposed member IDs and their spending
WITH exposed_members AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure ce
    INNER JOIN dim_member m ON ce.member_key = m.member_key
    WHERE ce.campaign_id = 19
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT em.member_id) as targeted_members,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as total_spending
FROM exposed_members em
LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON em.member_id = m.member_id
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.member_key = m.member_key 
    AND f.sale_date >= '2026-05-04'
    AND f.sale_date <= '2026-05-24'

-- Simple approach: count unique member_keys in exposure, sum spending by those keys
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) as exposed_members,
    SUM(fs.net_amount) as total_spending
FROM fact_campaign_exposure ce
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line fs ON ce.member_key = fs.member_key 
    AND fs.sale_date >= '2026-05-04'
    AND fs.sale_date <= '2026-05-24'
WHERE ce.campaign_id = 19

-- Count exposed members and calculate spending
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT ce.member_key) as exposed_members,
    SUM(fs.net_amount) as total_spending
FROM fact_campaign_exposure ce
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line fs ON ce.member_key = fs.member_key 
    AND fs.sale_date >= '2026-05-04'
    AND fs.sale_date <= '2026-05-24'
WHERE ce.campaign_id = 19

-- Check how many exposure records there are vs unique member_keys
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_exposure_records,
    COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) as unique_members
FROM fact_campaign_exposure
WHERE campaign_id = 19

-- Get exposed member IDs first, then sum spending
WITH exposed AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT member_key
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure
    WHERE campaign_id = 19
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as exposed_members,
    SUM(fs.net_amount) as total_spending
FROM exposed
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line fs ON exposed.member_key = fs.member_key 
    AND fs.sale_date >= '2026-05-04'
    AND fs.sale_date <= '2026-05-24'

-- Get distinct exposed members and their total spending
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id = 19) as exposed_members,
    SUM(fs.net_amount) as total_spending
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT member_key
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure
    WHERE campaign_id = 19
) exposed
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line fs ON exposed.member_key = fs.member_key 
    AND fs.sale_date >= '2026-05-04'
    AND fs.sale_date <= '2026-05-24'

-- Final verification: members contacted and their spending
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT ce.member_key) as members_contacted,
    SUM(fs.net_amount) as total_spending
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT member_key
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure
    WHERE campaign_id = 19
) ce
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line fs ON ce.member_key = fs.member_key 
    AND fs.sale_date >= '2026-05-04'
    AND fs.sale_date <= '2026-05-24'
